translation: Seventeen: I rubbed until after the full moon, and the face was already clear and the scalp also alive; the skin of Dazhui was also thin, and although the neck was thick it was also clean. Only the three segments of the neck bone, Yamen (啞門), Fengfu (風府), and Dazhui, were covered by hard sinews. Feeling the two sides of the neck, there was a point the size of a chopstick head on each; without letting go, I rubbed them, and after about half an hour the thick ones also came, growing thicker the higher they went, and I removed four strips in succession on left and right. Later I also rubbed above the ears, and suddenly two strips came out from the neck behind the ears, from above the ears to the forehead corners and brow tips, down to the jaw; and there were two more strips that came out from the front of the neck bone above the ear gate, going straight to the temples and forehead, crossing the crown, and descending from behind the head to the shoulders.
